maddeler.e:
نمتزج (form VIII)
# نَمْتَزِجُ (namtaziju) /nam.ta.zi.d͡ʒu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِمْتَزَجَ (imtazaja)
# نُمْتَزَجُ (numtazaju) /num.ta.za.d͡ʒu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَزَجَ (imtazaja)
# نَمْتَزِجَ (namtazija) /nam.ta.zi.d͡ʒa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِمْتَزَجَ (imtazaja)
# نُمْتَزَجَ (numtazaja) /num.ta.za
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
